promenade.name: Promenade des Anglais
promenade.hours: Open all day, check on the day for event closures
promenade.tip: Walk the seafront from the old town toward the airport end for the best sea views.
promenade.best: Early morning or sunset; spring and autumn are calmer

cathedral.name: Saint Nicholas Cathedral
cathedral.price_text: Donation or small entry fee, roughly EUR 3–6 (check on the day)
cathedral.hours: Usually daily, mid-morning to late afternoon; check on the day
cathedral.tip: Dress modestly and keep voices low during services. Photos may be restricted inside.
cathedral.best: Weekday mornings, when it is quieter

paloma.name: Paloma Beach
paloma.price_text: Public beach, free; sunbed rental roughly EUR 15–30 (check on the day)
paloma.hours: Open daily in summer; check season and hours on the day
paloma.tip: Bring water shoes, the pebbles are hard on bare feet.
paloma.best: Late spring to early autumn, mornings

antibes.name: Antibes Land
antibes.price_text: Check on the day; ticket prices vary
antibes.hours: Check on the day; seasonal opening
antibes.tip: Confirm it is open and book tickets online before you travel to Antibes.

cannes-festival.name: Cannes Film Festival
cannes-festival.price_text: Public access is limited; check official ticketing on the day
cannes-festival.hours: Held in May in Cannes; check dates before travel
cannes-festival.tip: The festival is in Cannes, about an hour by train from Nice. Public tickets are scarce, so plan ahead.

koaland.name: Koaland
koaland.tip: Check the location and opening days before going, as details change.

croisette.name: La Croisette
croisette.tip: Walk the boulevard in the morning, then stop at the beach clubs for a drink.
croisette.best: Late afternoon in spring or autumn

suquet.name: Le Suquet
suquet.tip: Climb the narrow streets to the old tower for views over the bay.

miserables.name: Les Misérables
miserables.price_text: Check on the day; literary walks vary
miserables.tip: Look for a literary walk linked to Victor Hugo's novel, and confirm the route before booking.

oceanographic.name: Oceanographic Museum
oceanographic.price_text: Roughly EUR 25–35 adult (check on the day)
oceanographic.hours: Daily; check seasonal hours on the day
oceanographic.tip: It is in Monaco, about 30 minutes by train from Nice. Combine it with the Prince's Palace.

palace.name: Prince's Palace of Monaco
palace.price_text: Roughly EUR 10–15 adult (check on the day)
palace.hours: Daily in season; check hours on the day
palace.tip: Arrive early for the changing of the guard at noon, and expect queues.

zygo.name: Zygo Park
zygo.tip: A quiet green space for a break. Confirm the location before you go.

cours-saleya.name: Cours Saleya Market
cours-saleya.price_text: Free to browse; food prices vary
cours-saleya.hours: Daily morning market; check on the day
cours-saleya.tip: Go early for flowers, produce and socca. Bargain politely for flowers and olives.

castle-hill.name: Castle Hill Viewpoint
castle-hill.tip: Take the lift or stairs up for the best view of the bay and the old town.

matisse.name: Matisse Museum
matisse.hours: Closed some days; check on the day
matisse.tip: It is in Cimiez, so take a bus or taxi. Pair it with the nearby Roman ruins.

old-town-tour.name: Old Town Food Walk
old-town-tour.price_text: Roughly EUR 50–75 per person (check on the day)
old-town-tour.hours: Usually daytime tours; check on the day
old-town-tour.tip: Book a small group walk to taste socca, pissaladière and local wine in one afternoon.
